mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 19, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note: aurora: violet and pink curtains fading into black - the aurora. Not a surface: drawn additively, so the black is nothing and the colour is light.
additive_from: ZzzObject.cpp, CreateObject, case WD_2DEVIAS: `o->BlendMesh = 0` for type 19 (:4697-4700), and the render path draws that submesh with RENDER_BRIGHT. It is the model's only mesh, so the whole curtain is light.
why_this_one: 136 of them hang 2 to 6 m over the whole map: Devias's aurora, which no earlier note had named.
animation_note: Rigged: 7 bones, one action of 30 keys - the curtain ripples. Plays at CreateObject's 0.16; Devias's arm sets no velocity.
